```{r}
# BZD / Z-drug meta-analysis: dataset import and validation (no model fits yet)
# In RStudio: Session > Set Working Directory > Choose Directory ...
# Select the folder containing the five BZD_..._v1.csv files.
# Install once: install.packages(c("readr", "dplyr", "metafor", "meta"))
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

registry <- "BZD_Study_Registry_v1.csv"
cess <- "BZD_Cessation_Core_v1.csv"
rel <- "BZD_Relapse_Core_v1.csv"
cess_long <- "BZD_Cessation_All_Arms_Timepoints_v1.csv"
rct_arms <- "BZD_Randomized_Intervention_Arms_v1.csv"
rel_original <- "BZD_Relapse_Original_Timepoints_v1.csv"
```


```{r}

datasets <- c(
  "BZD_Study_Registry_v1",
  "BZD_Cessation_Core_v1",
  "BZD_Cessation_All_Arms_Timepoints_v1",
  "BZD_Relapse_Core_v1",
  "BZD_Relapse_Original_Timepoints_v1",
  "BZD_Randomized_Intervention_Arms_v1"
)

# Check whether all six objects exist
setdiff(datasets, ls())

# Display the number of rows and columns
data.frame(
  Dataset = datasets,
  Rows = sapply(mget(datasets), nrow),
```

```{r}


library(dplyr)

cessation <- BZD_Cessation_Core_v1

end_taper <- cessation %>%
  filter(pool_with_end_taper == "YES") %>%
  select(
    study_id,
    events_free_n,
    at_risk_n,
    denominator_basis,
    meta_data_quality
  )

# Display all selected studies
print(end_taper)

# Count selected studies
nrow(end_taper)

# Check for missing or impossible values
invalid_rows <- end_taper %>%
  filter(
    is.na(events_free_n) |
    is.na(at_risk_n) |
    events_free_n > at_risk_n |
    events_free_n < 0 |
    at_risk_n <= 0
  )

print(invalid_rows)

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

end_taper_analysis <- end_taper %>%
  mutate(
    original_n = at_risk_n,
    at_risk_n = case_when(
      study_id == "BAILLARGEON2003" ~ 65,
      study_id == "FYER1988" ~ 14,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(at_risk_n)
    ),
    analysis_note = case_when(
      study_id == "BAILLARGEON2003" ~ "Missing treated as failure",
      study_id == "FYER1988" ~ "Missing treated as failure",
      study_id == "EDINGER2025" ~ "Blinded taper arms only",
      study_id == "OCONNOR2004" ~ "Panic disorder subgroup only",
      TRUE ~ "Source-reported denominator"
    ),
    success_rate = events_free_n / at_risk_n
  )

print(
  end_taper_analysis %>%
    select(study_id, events_free_n, at_risk_n,
           success_rate, analysis_note),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Final numerical verification
stopifnot(
  nrow(end_taper_analysis) == 9,
  all(end_taper_analysis$events_free_n <=
      end_taper_analysis$at_risk_n),
  all(end_taper_analysis$at_risk_n > 0)
)

```

```{r}

# Install only if necessary
if (!requireNamespace("meta", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("meta")
}

library(meta)

# Random-effects meta-analysis of discontinuation success
m_discont <- metaprop(
  event = events_free_n,
  n = at_risk_n,
  studlab = study_id,
  data = end_taper_analysis,
  sm = "PLOGIT",
  method = "GLMM",
  common = FALSE,
  random = TRUE
)

# Display the results
summary(m_discont)

# Generate forest plot
forest(
  m_discont,
  xlab = "Proportion successfully discontinued"
)

```

```{r}

library(meta)
library(dplyr)

# A1a: observed-case denominator sensitivity
end_taper_observed <- end_taper_analysis

end_taper_observed$at_risk_n[
  end_taper_observed$study_id == "BAILLARGEON2003"
] <- 63

end_taper_observed$at_risk_n[
  end_taper_observed$study_id == "FYER1988"
] <- 12

m_observed <- metaprop(
  event = events_free_n,
  n = at_risk_n,
  studlab = study_id,
  data = end_taper_observed,
  sm = "PLOGIT",
  method = "GLMM",
  common = FALSE,
  random = TRUE
)

# Compare both analyses
summary(m_observed)

comparison <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c(
    "A1: Missing treated as failure",
    "A1a: Observed cases"
  ),
  Studies = c(m_discont$k, m_observed$k),
  Pooled_percent = round(
    100 * plogis(c(
      m_discont$TE.random,
      m_observed$TE.random
    )), 2
  ),
  I2_percent = round(
    100 * c(m_discont$I2, m_observed$I2), 2
  )
)

print(comparison)
```

```{r}

library(meta)

# A1c: Leave-one-study-out analysis
loo_results <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(end_taper_analysis)),
  function(i) {

    reduced_data <- end_taper_analysis[-i, ]

    model <- metaprop(
      event = events_free_n,
      n = at_risk_n,
      studlab = study_id,
      data = reduced_data,
      sm = "PLOGIT",
      method = "GLMM",
      common = FALSE,
      random = TRUE
    )

    data.frame(
      study_removed = end_taper_analysis$study_id[i],
      k = model$k,
      pooled_percent = round(
        100 * plogis(model$TE.random), 2
      ),
      CI_lower = round(
        100 * plogis(model$lower.random), 2
      ),
      CI_upper = round(
        100 * plogis(model$upper.random), 2
      ),
      I2_percent = round(100 * model$I2, 2)
    )
  }
)

loo_results <- do.call(rbind, loo_results)

# Sort by pooled estimate
loo_results <- loo_results[
  order(loo_results$pooled_percent),
]

print(loo_results, row.names = FALSE)

# Save for the report
dir.create("BZD_results", showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  loo_results,
  "BZD_results/A1c_Leave_One_Out.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(meta)

# A2: Three-month BZD-free status
a2_source <- BZD_Cessation_All_Arms_Timepoints_v1 %>%
  filter(
    (
      study_id == "MORIN2004" &
      assessment_window == "3 months" &
      outcome_category == "Point nonuse"
    ) |
    (
      study_id %in% c("RICKELS2000", "RYNN2003") &
      assessment_window == "3-month posttaper"
    )
  )

# Combine mutually exclusive arms within each study
a2_3m <- a2_source %>%
  group_by(study_id) %>%
  summarise(
    events_free_n = sum(as.numeric(events_free_n)),
    at_risk_n = sum(as.numeric(denominator_n)),
    assessment = paste(
      unique(assessment_window), collapse = "; "
    ),
    denominator_note = paste(
      unique(denominator_type), collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(a2_3m)

# Verify the expected three studies
stopifnot(
  nrow(a2_3m) == 3,
  all(a2_3m$events_free_n <= a2_3m$at_risk_n),
  all(a2_3m$at_risk_n > 0)
)

# A2: Random-effects GLMM
m_a2_3m <- metaprop(
  event = events_free_n,
  n = at_risk_n,
  studlab = study_id,
  data = a2_3m,
  sm = "PLOGIT",
  method = "GLMM",
  common = FALSE,
  random = TRUE
)

summary(m_a2_3m)

forest(
  m_a2_3m,
  prediction = TRUE,
  xlab = "Proportion BZD-free at 3 months"
)

# Save results for the report
dir.create("BZD_results", showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  a2_3m,
  "BZD_results/A2_Three_Month_Data.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  m_a2_3m,
  "BZD_results/A2_Three_Month_Model.rds"
)

capture.output(
  summary(m_a2_3m),
  file = "BZD_results/A2_Three_Month_Results.txt"
)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

b1 <- BZD_Relapse_Core_v1 %>%
  filter(ascertainment_family == "Direct resumption") %>%
  transmute(
    study_id,
    relapsed = as.integer(events_n),
    previously_free = as.integer(
      prior_successful_discontinuers_n
    ),
    followup = reported_followup,
    relapse_definition = relapse_event_definition
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(b1) == 5,
  !anyDuplicated(b1$study_id),
  all(!is.na(b1$relapsed)),
  all(!is.na(b1$previously_free)),
  all(b1$relapsed >= 0),
  all(b1$previously_free > 0),
  all(b1$relapsed <= b1$previously_free)
)

# Exact binomial 95% confidence intervals
ci <- t(vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(b1)),
  function(i) {
    binom.test(
      b1$relapsed[i],
      b1$previously_free[i]
    )$conf.int
  },
  numeric(2)
))

b1 <- b1 %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = relapsed / previously_free,
    ci_lower = ci[, 1],
    ci_upper = ci[, 2]
  )

print(as.data.frame(b1), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}

draw_b1_forest <- function() {

  oldpar <- par(mar = c(5, 17, 4, 3))
  on.exit(par(oldpar))

  y <- rev(seq_len(nrow(b1)))

  plot(
    b1$proportion, y,
    xlim = c(0, 1),
    ylim = c(0.5, nrow(b1) + 0.5),
    xlab = "Proportion resuming BZD/Z-drug use",
    ylab = "",
    yaxt = "n",
    pch = 15,
    cex = 1.2
  )

  segments(
    b1$ci_lower, y,
    b1$ci_upper, y,
    lwd = 2
  )

  axis(
    2, at = y,
    labels = b1$study_id,
    las = 1,
    tick = FALSE
  )

  title("B1: Post-discontinuation resumption")
}

# View the forest plot in RStudio
draw_b1_forest()

# Save results
dir.create("BZD_results", showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  b1,
  "BZD_results/B1_Direct_Relapse_Data.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

png(
  "BZD_results/B1_Direct_Relapse_Forest.png",
  width = 1800,
  height = 1000,
  res = 170
)

draw_b1_forest()
dev.off()

```

```{r}
# BZD/Z-drug review — A0 and B0 broad model workflow
# 2026-10-28. This script runs analyses locally IN YOUR RSTUDIO SESSION.
# It does not run any previously completed A1-A3 or B1-B2 analyses.
# Required: A0/B0 CSV files downloaded into the same directory as your R working directory.
# To see/change the directory: getwd(); setwd("C:/your/path/to/extracted/package")
# Alternative: read the files using RStudio's Import Dataset menu first and adapt names below.

library(readr)

a0 <- BZD_A0_Maximum_Inclusive_19_v2
b0 <- BZD_B0_Maximum_Inclusive_9_v2
  

# Verify imports
class(a0)
class(b0)

nrow(a0)
nrow(b0)

# Stage 0: audit numerical values, cohort independence, and special cases
stopifnot(nrow(a0) == 19, nrow(b0) == 9,
          !anyDuplicated(a0$cohort_id), !anyDuplicated(b0$cohort_id),
          all(a0$successes >= 0 & a0$successes <= a0$denominator),
          all(b0$relapsed >= 0 & b0$relapsed <= b0$at_risk_prior_discontinuers),
          all(!is.na(a0$successes)), all(!is.na(a0$denominator)),
          all(!is.na(b0$relapsed)), all(!is.na(b0$at_risk_prior_discontinuers)))

cat("A0 included IDs and endpoints:\n")
print(as.data.frame(a0[, c("study_id", "successes", "denominator", "timing_group", "interpretation_flags")]), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nB0 included IDs and ascertainment:\n")
print(as.data.frame(b0[, c("study_id", "relapsed", "at_risk_prior_discontinuers", "ascertainment_family", "followup")]), row.names = FALSE)

# A0: MAXIMUM INCLUSIVE — study-defined cessation/medication-free outcome.
# Interpret this model ONLY as a heterogenous study-defined summary across
# different time origins, assessment windows, and participant sampling frames.
# It is NOT the chance of successfully finishing a specified taper programme.
m_a0_19 <- metaprop(
  event = successes, n = denominator, studlab = study_id, data = a0,
  sm = "PLOGIT", method = "GLMM", common = FALSE, random = TRUE,
  prediction = TRUE
)
cat("\n===== A0: Broad study-defined cessation (k=19) =====\n")
print(summary(m_a0_19))
forest(m_a0_19, prediction = TRUE,
       xlab = "Study-defined cessation / BZD-free proportion")

# A0 sensitivity: the Raju service cohort did not establish that everyone
# attempted a taper, unlike most included cohorts; remove that sampling frame.
a0_without_service <- a0[a0$study_id != "RAJU2005", ]
stopifnot(nrow(a0_without_service) == 18)
m_a0_18 <- metaprop(
  event = successes, n = denominator, studlab = study_id,
  data = a0_without_service, sm = "PLOGIT", method = "GLMM",
  common = FALSE, random = TRUE, prediction = TRUE
)
cat("\n===== A0a: Without service cohort (k=18) =====\n")
print(summary(m_a0_18))

# B0: MAXIMUM INCLUSIVE — documented resumption after prior BZD-free state.
# This is not cumulative FIRST relapse at a common follow-up horizon.
# Four of nine cohorts only identify observed off-to-on status transitions.
m_b0_9 <- metaprop(
  event = relapsed, n = at_risk_prior_discontinuers,
  studlab = study_id, data = b0,
  sm = "PLOGIT", method = "GLMM", common = FALSE, random = TRUE,
  prediction = TRUE
)
cat("\n===== B0: Study-defined documented resumption (k=9) =====\n")
print(summary(m_b0_9))
forest(m_b0_9, prediction = TRUE,
       xlab = "Documented resumption (varying follow-up / definitions)")

```
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(meta)

cbt_data <- BZD_Randomized_Intervention_Arms_v1 %>%
  filter(
    comparison_family == "CBT+taper vs non-CBT taper"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    success_n = as.numeric(success_n),
    total_n = as.numeric(total_n)
  )

# CBT-containing treatment arms
cbt_treatment <- cbt_data %>%
  filter(is_reference == "NO") %>%
  transmute(
    study_id,
    event.e = success_n,
    n.e = total_n
  )

# Comparator arms
cbt_control <- cbt_data %>%
  filter(is_reference == "YES") %>%
  transmute(
    study_id,
    event.c = success_n,
    n.c = total_n
  )

# Match randomized arms within each study
c1 <- inner_join(
  cbt_treatment,
  cbt_control,
  by = "study_id"
)

print(c1)

stopifnot(
  nrow(c1) == 3,
  !anyDuplicated(c1$study_id),
  all(c1$event.e <= c1$n.e),
  all(c1$event.c <= c1$n.c)
)

```
```{r}

m_c1 <- metabin(
  event.e = event.e,
  n.e = n.e,
  event.c = event.c,
  n.c = n.c,
  studlab = study_id,
  data = c1,
  sm = "RR",
  method = "Inverse",
  method.tau = "REML",
  method.random.ci = "HK",
  common = FALSE,
  random = TRUE
)

summary(m_c1)

forest(
  m_c1,
  xlab = "Risk ratio of successful discontinuation",
  label.e = "CBT-containing taper",
  label.c = "Comparator",
  label.left = "Favors comparator",
  label.right = "Favors CBT"
)

```
```{r}


library(meta)

# C1a: Hartung-Knapp with variance safeguard
m_c1_safe <- update(
  m_c1,
  method.random.ci = "HK",
  adhoc.hakn.ci = "se"
)

# C1b: Conventional random-effects confidence interval
m_c1_classic <- update(
  m_c1,
  method.random.ci = "classic",
  adhoc.hakn.ci = ""
)

# Compare the two methods
summary(m_c1_safe)
summary(m_c1_classic)

# Forest plot using safeguarded HK
forest(
  m_c1_safe,
  xlab = "RR of successful discontinuation",
  label.e = "CBT-containing taper",
  label.c = "Comparator",
  label.left = "Favors comparator",
  label.right = "Favors CBT"
)


# Plot the safeguarded model
forest(
  m_c1_safe,
  xlab = "RR of successful discontinuation",
  label.e = "CBT-containing taper",
  label.c = "Comparator"
)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

drug_arms <- BZD_Randomized_Intervention_Arms_v1 %>%
  filter(
    comparison_family ==
      "Imipramine vs buspirone vs placebo"
  )

compare_drugs <- function(treatment, comparator) {

  treated <- drug_arms %>%
    filter(arm == treatment) %>%
    transmute(
      study_id,
      event_e = as.numeric(success_n),
      n_e = as.numeric(total_n)
    )

  control <- drug_arms %>%
    filter(arm == comparator) %>%
    transmute(
      study_id,
      event_c = as.numeric(success_n),
      n_c = as.numeric(total_n)
    )

  dat <- inner_join(treated, control, by = "study_id")

  stopifnot(
    nrow(dat) == 2,
    !anyDuplicated(dat$study_id),
    all(dat$event_e > 0),
    all(dat$event_c > 0)
  )

  dat %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = paste(treatment, "vs", comparator),
      RR = (event_e / n_e) / (event_c / n_c),
      se_logRR = sqrt(
        1/event_e - 1/n_e +
        1/event_c - 1/n_c
      ),
      lower = exp(log(RR) - 1.96 * se_logRR),
      upper = exp(log(RR) + 1.96 * se_logRR)
    ) %>%
    select(
      comparison, study_id,
      event_e, n_e,
      event_c, n_c,
      RR, lower, upper
    )
}

c2_results <- bind_rows(
  compare_drugs("Imipramine", "Placebo"),
  compare_drugs("Buspirone", "Placebo"),
  compare_drugs("Imipramine", "Buspirone")
)

print(as.data.frame(c2_results), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  c2_results,
  "BZD_results/C2_Medication_Comparisons.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
```{r}

library(meta)

# C2: Three exploratory two-study meta-analyses

comparisons <- c(
  "Imipramine vs Placebo",
  "Buspirone vs Placebo",
  "Imipramine vs Buspirone"
)

c2_models <- list()

for (comp in comparisons) {

  dat <- subset(
    c2_results,
    comparison == comp
  )

  stopifnot(
    nrow(dat) == 2,
    !anyDuplicated(dat$study_id)
  )

  model <- metabin(
    event.e = event_e,
    n.e = n_e,
    event.c = event_c,
    n.c = n_c,
    studlab = study_id,
    data = dat,
    sm = "RR",
    method = "Inverse",
    method.tau = "REML",
    method.random.ci = "classic",
    common = FALSE,
    random = TRUE
  )

  c2_models[[comp]] <- model

  cat("\n===========================\n")
  cat("C2:", comp, "\n")
  cat("===========================\n")

  print(summary(model))
}

# Summarize the exploratory pooled estimates
c2_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(c2_models), function(comp) {

    model <- c2_models[[comp]]

    data.frame(
      comparison = comp,
      k = model$k,
      RR = exp(model$TE.random),
      CI_lower = exp(model$lower.random),
      CI_upper = exp(model$upper.random),
      I2_percent = 100 * model$I2
    )
  })
)

print(c2_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

# C3: Other pharmacological interventions
comparisons_c3 <- c(
  "Carbamazepine vs placebo",
  "Paroxetine vs placebo",
  "Cyamemazine vs bromazepam substitution"
)

c3_arms <- BZD_Randomized_Intervention_Arms_v1 %>%
  filter(comparison_family %in% comparisons_c3) %>%
  mutate(
    success_n = as.numeric(success_n),
    total_n = as.numeric(total_n)
  )

# Calculate trial-specific RRs
c3_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(comparisons_c3, function(comp) {

    dat <- c3_arms[
      c3_arms$comparison_family == comp, 
    ]

    stopifnot(
      nrow(dat) == 2,
      setequal(dat$is_reference, c("YES", "NO"))
    )

    treated <- dat[dat$is_reference == "NO", ]
    control <- dat[dat$is_reference == "YES", ]

    a <- treated$success_n
    n1 <- treated$total_n
    c <- control$success_n
    n0 <- control$total_n

    stopifnot(
      a > 0, c > 0,
      a <= n1, c <= n0
    )

    RR <- (a / n1) / (c / n0)

    SE <- sqrt(
      1/a - 1/n1 + 1/c - 1/n0
    )

    data.frame(
      comparison = comp,
      study_id = treated$study_id,
      treatment = treated$arm,
      event_e = a,
      n_e = n1,
      comparator = control$arm,
      event_c = c,
      n_c = n0,
      RR = RR,
      CI_lower = exp(log(RR) - 1.96 * SE),
      CI_upper = exp(log(RR) + 1.96 * SE)
    )
  })
)

print(c3_results, row.names = FALSE)

# Save the results
dir.create("BZD_results", showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  c3_results,
  "BZD_results/C3_Other_Medication_Comparisons.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# D2 v4: exploratory population ascertainment comparisons
# Requires install.packages("meta") once, if needed.
library(meta)

d2a <- BZD_D2A_Expanded_Discontinuation_29_v4
d2b <- BZD_D2B_Expanded_Relapse_14_v4

for (x in list(d2a,d2b)) {
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(x$cohort_id),
            all(!is.na(x$events_n)), all(!is.na(x$total_n)),
            all(x$events_n >= 0), all(x$total_n > 0),
            all(x$events_n <= x$total_n))
}
stopifnot(nrow(d2a)==29, nrow(d2b)==14)
stopifnot(sum(d2a$population_group == "Diagnosed psychiatric cohort")==19,
          sum(d2a$population_group == "Diagnosis not required / not established")==10,
          sum(d2b$population_group == "Diagnosed psychiatric cohort")==9,
          sum(d2b$population_group == "Diagnosis not required / not established")==5)
stopifnot(d2b$events_n[d2b$study_id=="MOL2007_STEP2_TAPER"] == 24,
          d2b$total_n[d2b$study_id=="MOL2007_STEP2_TAPER"] == 45)
print(table(d2a$population_group))
print(table(d2b$population_group))
print(subset(d2b, shared_programme_id=="BENZOREDUX",
             select=c(study_id,cohort_id,events_n,total_n,shared_programme_id)))

# Pool *within* categories using random-effects GLMM.
# Differences are ecological / study-level comparisons, NOT causality.
fit_d2 <- function(dat) {
  metaprop(event=events_n,n=total_n,studlab=study_id,data=dat,
           sm="PLOGIT",method="GLMM",common=FALSE,random=TRUE,
           subgroup=population_group,prediction=FALSE)
}
m_d2a29 <- fit_d2(d2a)
m_d2b14 <- fit_d2(d2b)
summary(m_d2a29)
summary(m_d2b14)

# Sensitivity A: reproduce previous v3 relapse study selection, without Mol.
m_d2b_without_mol <- fit_d2(subset(d2b,study_id!="MOL2007_STEP2_TAPER"))
summary(m_d2b_without_mol)

# Sensitivity B: omit proxy broad hypnotic outcome and observed later status reversal.
m_d2b_direct <- fit_d2(subset(d2b,!study_id %in%
                              c("BELLEVILLE2008","VICENSCALDENTEY2008")))
summary(m_d2b_direct)

# Sensitivity C: research-programme influence (not claims of duplicated persons).
m_d2b_without_gorgels <- fit_d2(subset(d2b,study_id!="GORGELS2005"))
summary(m_d2b_without_gorgels)

# Continue previously prepared discontinuation sensitivity.
m_d2a_sens <- fit_d2(subset(d2a,!study_id %in%
                            c("RAJU2005","MERCIER2004","VICENS2016","VICENSCALDENTEY2008")))
summary(m_d2a_sens)

dir.create("BZD_results", showWarnings=FALSE)
for (nm in c("D2A_Expanded_k29_v4","D2B_Expanded_k14_v4")) {
  mod <- if (nm=="D2A_Expanded_k29_v4") m_d2a29 else m_d2b14
  pdf(file.path("BZD_results",paste0(nm,".pdf")),width=17,
      height=if (nm=="D2A_Expanded_k29_v4") 17 else 12)
  forest(mod,xlab="Study-defined event proportion",fontsize=9,
         leftcols=c("studlab","event","n"),
         rightcols=c("effect","ci"))
  dev.off()
}
saveRDS(m_d2a29,"BZD_results/D2A_Expanded_k29_v4.rds")
saveRDS(m_d2b14,"BZD_results/D2B_Expanded_k14_v4.rds")
write.csv(d2b,"BZD_results/D2B_Expanded_k14_v4_data.csv",row.names=FALSE)
capture.output(summary(m_d2a29),file="BZD_results/D2A_Expanded_k29_v4_output.txt")
capture.output(summary(m_d2b14),file="BZD_results/D2B_Expanded_k14_v4_output.txt")

cat("Completed D2 v4. Please share summary(m_d2b14) and summary(m_d2b_without_mol).\n")
```

```{r}
# D3 — Relapse: endpoint-definition and follow-up comparability assessment
# Run AFTER D2 v4. The 14-row data frame d2b must already exist in RStudio.
# NO read.csv() or reimport needed. 'meta' is the only required package.

library(meta)
stopifnot(is.data.frame(d2b), nrow(d2b)==14,
          all(c("study_id","cohort_id","population_group","events_n","total_n","shared_programme_id") %in% names(d2b)))

# The coding is derived from source-noted D2B v4 definitions.
# Follow-up month bounds are descriptive (NOT comparable person-time or fixed-time risks).
d3_code <- data.frame(
  study_id = c("COUVEE2002","DUPONT1992","GAREL2023","GOSSELIN2006",
               "PRIEBE1988","RAJU2005","RICKELS2000","RYNN2003",
               "VORMA2003","GARFINKEL1999","GORGELS2005","BELLEVILLE2008",
               "VICENSCALDENTEY2008","MOL2007_STEP2_TAPER"),
  event_type_d3 = c(
    "Prescription-based BZD/Z resumption","Direct BZD/Z resumption",
    "Direct BZD/Z resumption","Direct BZD/Z resumption",
    "Direct BZD/Z resumption","Observed off-to-on status",
    "Observed off-to-on status","Observed off-to-on status",
    "Observed off-to-on status","Direct BZD/Z resumption",
    "Prescription-based BZD/Z resumption","Broader hypnotic resumption",
    "Observed off-to-on status","Prescription-based BZD/Z resumption"),
  followup_lower_months = c(NA,NA,3,3,8,12,3,3,0,6,15,0,12,15),
  followup_upper_months = c(NA,NA,24,6,16,24,12,12,12,6,15,6,36,15),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(d3_code$study_id), setequal(d2b$study_id, d3_code$study_id))
d3 <- cbind(d2b, d3_code[match(d2b$study_id,d3_code$study_id),
                         c("event_type_d3","followup_lower_months","followup_upper_months")])
d3$observed_proportion <- d3$events_n/d3$total_n

cat("\nD3a — Types of evidence by population\n")
print(with(d3, table(population_group,event_type_d3)))
cat("\nD3b — Study-level follow-up and relapse definition\n")
print(d3[,c("study_id","population_group","events_n","total_n",
            "observed_proportion","followup","event_type_d3")],row.names=FALSE)

# Harmonize the *type of event*, while retaining prescriptions as a documented
# proxy for renewed BZD use. Excludes status reversals and non-specific hypnotics.
d3_direct <- subset(d3, event_type_d3 %in% c(
  "Direct BZD/Z resumption","Prescription-based BZD/Z resumption"))
stopifnot(nrow(d3_direct)==8,
          sum(d3_direct$population_group=="Diagnosed psychiatric cohort")==5,
          sum(d3_direct$population_group=="Diagnosis not required / not established")==3)

fit_d3 <- function(dat) {
  metaprop(event=events_n,n=total_n,studlab=study_id,data=dat,
           sm="PLOGIT",method="GLMM",common=FALSE,random=TRUE,
           subgroup=population_group,prediction=FALSE)
}

cat("\nD3c — Sensitivity: documented BZD/Z resumption ONLY (k=8)\n")
m_d3_direct_k8 <- fit_d3(d3_direct)
print(summary(m_d3_direct_k8))

# Shared-programme influence: Gorgels and Mol are participant-disjoint risk
# sets but come from the same Benzoredux programme. Exclude BOTH as sensitivity.
d3_no_benzoredux <- subset(d3, is.na(shared_programme_id) |
                             shared_programme_id != "BENZOREDUX")
stopifnot(nrow(d3_no_benzoredux)==12,
          sum(d3_no_benzoredux$population_group=="Diagnosis not required / not established")==3)
cat("\nD3d — Sensitivity: exclude both Benzoredux estimates (k=12)\n")
m_d3_no_benzoredux_k12 <- fit_d3(d3_no_benzoredux)
print(summary(m_d3_no_benzoredux_k12))

# Follow-up upper limit <=12 months. This is a DESCRIPTIVE study audit, not a
# standardized 12-month incidence analysis, and a between-group test is NOT
# justified: only two comparator studies, one with broader hypnotic events.
d3_within12 <- subset(d3, !is.na(followup_upper_months) &
                      followup_upper_months <= 12)
cat("\nD3e — Studies whose reported follow-up window ends by 12 months\n")
print(d3_within12[,c("study_id","population_group","events_n","total_n",
                       "observed_proportion","followup","event_type_d3")],row.names=FALSE)
print(table(d3_within12$population_group))
cat("\nNO adjusted meta-regression or fixed-12-month comparison is warranted with these data.\n")

# Direct BZD/Z-only comparison after ALSO excluding both Benzoredux estimates
# has just one general-comparator cohort; therefore do not fit subgroup test.
strict_non_benzo <- subset(d3_direct, is.na(shared_programme_id) |
                           shared_programme_id != "BENZOREDUX")
cat("\nD3f — Strict direct definition excluding programme-linked studies\n")
print(table(strict_non_benzo$population_group))

# Save a complete audit and outputs (you can share them with me).
dir.create("BZD_results",showWarnings=FALSE)
write.csv(d3,"BZD_results/D3_14_Study_Definitions_and_Followup.csv",row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(d3_direct,"BZD_results/D3_Direct_BZD_8_Studies.csv",row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(d3_no_benzoredux,"BZD_results/D3_No_Benzoredux_12_Studies.csv",row.names=FALSE)
capture.output(summary(m_d3_direct_k8),
  file="BZD_results/D3_Direct_k8_Output.txt")
capture.output(summary(m_d3_no_benzoredux_k12),
  file="BZD_results/D3_No_Benzoredux_k12_Output.txt")
saveRDS(m_d3_direct_k8,"BZD_results/D3_Direct_k8_Model.rds")
saveRDS(m_d3_no_benzoredux_k12,"BZD_results/D3_No_Benzoredux_k12_Model.rds")
cat("\nD3 completed. Share summary(m_d3_direct_k8), summary(m_d3_no_benzoredux_k12), and the two tables.\n")
```
